notes.title: One Month of Firefly Village
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone.  Josh here!  [/p][p]It’s hard to believe Firefly Village launched [i]a month ago[/i]! I’m so grateful for all the kind words, helpful feedback, and the time you’ve spent in the village so far. Seeing the reviews and stories you’ve shared has been a huge boost. Thank you. 💛[/p][p]This first month has been a mix of fixing the rough edges, enjoying your feedback, and watching the community grow. I don’t have a big patch to announce today — just a heartfelt thanks and a note that I’m still listening. [/p][p]👉 If you’ve been playing, I’d love to hear: [b]what’s one small thing you’d like to see more of in Firefly Village?[/b] No promises, but I always enjoy seeing what parts of the game resonate most. [/p][p]Thanks again for making the first month so special — and if you haven’t yet, leaving a short review helps a lot.🌱[/p][p]Josh [/p]

notes.title: Regarding Steam Deck saves
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, I need to address an issue with the last patch.[/p][p]Without getting too technical, I changed how the game is exported.  Not only is the new version more stable, but it also interfaces way better with Steam (hello achievements!).[/p][p]But I didn't understand the Steam Deck's architecture well enough and I made some mistakes. It sounds like many Steam Deck users lost their saves during the transition.[/p][p]I'm really sorry.  I know it stings to invest time in something and have it disappear.[/p][p]I identified where I messed up, so this shouldn't happen again. [/p][p]Thank you for your patience.
As long as you keep supporting me, I'll keep making this game better.[/p][p]Josh[/p]

notes.title: Retroactive Achievements and Well Behaved Slimes!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Josh here! 👋

Achievements seem to be working for everyone now! I'm SO happy to hear that. 🎉

But what if you earned achievements while they were broken? Did you miss out? 😰

I just pushed a little patch that will check for any "one time" achievements (ie, becoming best friends with someone, buying an animal, upgrading your house, etc) and retroactively give you the achievements when you load your save!

(Some achievements, like attending festivals or finding a rainbow gem, don't have any kind of permanent flags, so you'll have to earn those the old fashioned way unfortunately.)

ALSO, the mine slimes will sit still when you pause the game!  So no more ambushes while you're sorting through your inventory.

Both of these were suggestions from the community, by the way. So keep 'em coming! 💡

Lots of love,
Josh ❤️

notes.title: Update: Double Inputs and BitDefender False Positives
notes.content:
Hi everyone, Josh here! 👋

Two quick updates:

[b]🎮 Controller Double Input Fix[/b]
I saw a couple reports of users getting double letters with a single button press on the name entry screen. I'll be honest, I couldn't reproduce this on my end, but I've added some extra safeguards that should prevent any double inputs. Can you let me know if it worked? If you're still experiencing issues, please share your setup details (especially what type of controller you're using) so I can dig deeper!

[b]🛡️ BitDefender False Positive[/b]
BitDefender Antivirus is incorrectly flagging Firefly Village as malicious - specifically the node.dll file (which is a standard component of NW.js that tons of games use). I've submitted a ticket to BitDefender support and hopefully they'll whitelist it soon. In the meantime, the game is completely safe - this is just an overzealous antivirus detection.

What's next?

🗣️ Tilly is STILL sometimes speaking Chinese in the English version despite my previous "fix". She just really wants to impress you with her multilingual abilities! I'll have another chat with her about sticking to one language at a time.

🎯 Steam Deck achievements are still being stubborn. Steam Deck support is new territory for me, and I definitely underestimated the challenge. But I have a few more ideas up my sleeve, so hopefully we'll crack this soon!

Thank you as always for your patience and support! 💚
Josh

notes.title: Welcome to Firefly Village!
notes.content:
Hi! I'm Josh, a solo game dev. Some of you might know me from my last game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1614360/Super_Ember_Kaboom/]Super Ember Kaboom[/url].

This is my newest game, [b]Firefly Village[/b]. It's a cozy-and-compact farming sim, with a focused cast and shorter days. It has the same snappy, colorful, and juicy gameplay that people loved from Ember, but recontextualizes it into something new.

That's not all, this time I've teamed up with a publisher: [b]indie.io[/b]!

Why?

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

To be honest, I was skeptical about signing on with a publisher. As you'd expect, most publishers just wanted me to make [i]Stardew-Valley-but-bigger[/i].  But indie.io actually seems to "get" my vision and is committed to supporting it.  So, long story short, I made the leap!

Together we're really making something awesome. I'd deeply appreciate it if you follow and wishlist to keep updated. Heck, even just liking this post would make my day.

Love,
Josh


You can see indie.io’s portfolio [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio?snr=1_2108_9__2107]here[/url].

PS: I’m also trying out [url=https://www.instagram.com/fireflyvillagegame/]instagram[/url]. I figured it’d be a fun way to share features and behind the scenes stuff.  Come follow if you're interested!
